correctness.rationale: The variable-radius packing criterion follows by equal-radius lower witnesses and a dyadic-radius upper decomposition. Applied to the Menssen--Younsi inf-harmonic diameter construction, it removes the quasi-Assouad scale-gap condition while preserving divergent normalized packing sums after quasiconformal transfer. The symmetric adaptation retains a fixed fraction of every source diameter.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Menssen--Younsi arXiv:2609.19522v1 explicitly asks as Question 1.11 whether their quasi-Assouad inf-harmonic theorem extends to full Assouad dimension and states that they were unable to prove it. Searches found no earlier affirmative solution. The auxiliary packing lemma and prior inf-harmonic/quasiconformal machinery are not claimed as new.

value.rationale: The result answers an explicit current open question, upgrades the full parameter dependence beyond the previously known two-point quasiconformal distortion inequality, and yields a symmetric full-Assouad analogue with a Smirnov-type quasicircle consequence.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
